response.message:
The shipping method you requested, 'expres', is not available. The closest option is 'Express'. Would you like to select 'Express' instead? Additionally, I will select 'Include gift wrap' as requested.
Review these 2 proposed field changes. Nothing has been changed yet.

fixes: Owned cancellation of a superseded read has TASK_CANCELLED and does not create a raw AbortError banner. Genuine connection interruption remains visible, with no automatic write retry.
Read-only field location resolves fresh observed refs through the scoped proposal/consume path, displays a ten-second marker, scrolls to the input and verifies no write. Ambiguous targets clarify.
Show me where reuses the latest question or page request; clear conversation and End task remove that browser-local context. @handoff and Save are not reused as page-location requests.
An active private file task no longer diverts field pointing into a document summary or waits unnecessarily for extraction.
Generic relative preferences reach semantic review; unsupported literal names remain blocked. Capitalized summary commands are not treated as document subjects.

Checker instructions agree with the maker on obvious observed-option spelling variants, retain clarification for ambiguity and request concise structured feedback. Earlier malformed verdict failures are preserved; a passing rerun is not a general model-stability guarantee.
recommendations: The actual global route passes with the approved passive checker. Historical Ollama MODEL_TIMEOUT failures remain in the evidence; they are not certified by switching routes.
The user-approved Admin setting now uses the inactive platform checker with maker/checker enabled. Repair and certify Ollama efficiency mode before selecting it again; no per-website override exists.
Broader Phase 1/2 remains 14 Passed / 16 Partial / 2 Deferred requirement families in the linked acceptance report; these narrower regression groups do not reclassify those gates.
Real Safari/iOS, Android Chrome and full screen-reader verification remain user-deferred. Existing targets do not prove fresh-owner email/DNS onboarding without backend seeding.
Refresh existing website tabs to load the deployed widget. The automated checks used fresh isolated browser contexts and did not reload user-owned tabs.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Native partial edits, choice controls and verified no-op
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Retain the different-control and no-op regressions.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Invalid and missing field facts
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Keep browser validation authoritative; never invent missing business data.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Country → Province → City dependencies
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Keep fresh refs per stage; regression covers overlapping labels and reordered choice evidence.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Async picklists and React/Angular state
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Continue framework fixtures when adapters change.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Table row identity through sort/filter/pagination
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Refuse stale row identity rather than reusing a numeric position.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Native Save validity and precise field errors
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Preserve field-specific validity categories without leaking host values.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Host business rejection and bounded repair
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Failure/partial-state handling is covered. A full browser rejection → supported repair → renewed review → Save journey remains to be demonstrated.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Unsupported/ambiguous controls and private frame boundaries
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Modal and boundary regressions pass. Complete a real inaccessible-frame/closed-shadow host journey before claiming this entire family.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Saved record with lost acknowledgement
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Real host persisted one record; deliberately dropped response stayed unknown, with one dispatch and no replay.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Duplicate dispatch, expired grant and recovery fences
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: SQLite reopen, persistent workflow operation guard and click deduplication pass; preserve tombstones during recovery.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Concurrent host edits, edited/rejected reviews
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Fresh edited proposal replaces the old approval; stale host edits are retained.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Stop, expiry, End task and revoked authority
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Keep server policy recheck immediately before every dispatch; no offline command replay.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Workflow Customer → Note → Opportunity saved journey
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Eleven real WebSocket commands saved/read back three local records; policy adapter is simulated there. Actual Flolah runner is tested separately. One fresh signed-in Flolah workflow run and CRM foreign-key linkage are not proved by this combined evidence.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Maker/checker functional and failure routes
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Maker-only/passive routes pass at 2048 tokens. The actual shared Ollama route offered Express for review in 94 seconds, but its cited-summary request failed closed at the 180-second checker deadline. Polling now remains bounded; this independent checker issue remains open with screenshot evidence.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Visible stages, elapsed progress and Stop
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: HTTP abort releases real capacity; Stop cancels remaining effects and never undoes a dispatched write.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Typed editable and rejectable reviews
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Nine representative editor types pass; every revision revalidates structure and invalidates old approval.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Persistent errors, action notices and accessibility
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Chrome keyboard and notices pass. Full screen-reader announcement validation is explicitly deferred by the user on 19 October; it is not an implementation partial.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Separate panel, task, group and counterpart state
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Lifecycle/session/pairing tests and explicit connection copy pass; ended private context is not resurrected.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Sender, recipient and workflow-run trace consistency
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Recipient completion now waits for coordinator acknowledgement. A fresh live Flolah run screenshot must close the three-surface UI comparison.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Held-out language and intelligent clarification
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Typos, checkbox language, radio intent, default plurals, preserve-current, unavailable choice, advice and cited summary pass. Broader comparisons/conflicting/missing-fact language is not fully measured.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Fresh owner email sign-in and empty registration
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Simulated clean-owner flow passes. Existing registrations were reused as requested, so a new real inbox/owner registration was not tested.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Real DNS ownership and challenge recovery
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Missing/wrong/renewed challenge and race guards pass in the resolver fixture. No new real DNS TXT change was made.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Actual installation, origin and diagnostics
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Both authorized live origins initialize; expiry/origin/CSP error contracts remain covered. Installed tokens are not published in screenshots.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Persisted discovery and cross-site isolation
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Persistence/isolation regressions pass. Reusing existing registrations does not prove one fresh owner discovered an entirely new site unassisted.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Teach → task test → publish → fresh visitor replay
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Actual consumed/observed proposal evidence gates task-tested readiness, and publication carries only unchanged tested steps. Full UI teaching-to-fresh-visitor chain remains open.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Owner setup resumption and website isolation
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Server state, ownership and paging regressions pass; live owner logout/login plus two-account browser resumption remains unperformed.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Disable/revoke invalidates readiness and execution
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Server revocation and policy-at-dispatch tests pass. Complete the owner UI disable/revoke → visitor UI refusal chain.

broaderRequirementCases.title: No domain-specific backend seeding
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Clean self-service fixture asserts empty content. Existing live registrations have historical operator setup; that history cannot be relabelled unseeded.

broaderRequirementCases.title: 25 websites and concurrent real planning workload
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: 500 management requests: zero errors, 112.97 ms p95; 25 tasks/50 recipients pass. Concurrent inference queue/stage/search-memory capacity remains unmeasured.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Bounded multi-format parsing and private memory
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: 25 real text files / two workers pass, with zero retained extraction bytes or cleanup backlog. A new concurrent PDF+image workload is still required.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Real 24-hour retention elapsed deletion
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Immediate ended-task denial and actual ISM policy passed previously. Verify physical deletion after its real elapsed cycle; do not shorten the shared policy to manufacture a pass.

broaderRequirementCases.title: Desktop keyboard plus deferred devices/assistive tech
broaderRequirementCases.recommendation: Desktop Chrome passes. The user explicitly deferred real Safari/iOS, Android and full screen-reader checks on 19 October. These are excluded from the active certification scope until resumed.
